titleStmt.title: Report of a committee of the honorable the privy council for Canada, approved by his excellency the governor-general on the 14th June, 1886.

opener.seg: [Inclosure 1 in Earl Rosebery’s instruction of July 23, 1886.]

div.head: Report of a committee of the honorable the privy council for Canada, approved by his excellency the governor-general on the 14th June, 1886.
div.p: The committee of the privy council have had under consideration a report from the minister of marine and fisheries upon the communications dated 10th and 20th May last from the Hon. Mr. Bayard, Secretary of State of the United States, to Her Majesty’s minister at Washington, in reference to the seizure of the American fishing-vessel David J. Adams.
The committee concur in the annexed report, and they advise that your excellency be moved to transmit a copy thereof to the Eight Hon. the Secretary of State for the Colonies.
All of which is respectfully submitted for your excellency’s approval.

closer.signed:
JOHN J. McGEE,
Clerk, Privy Council, Canada.
